224 days + 5 days = 229 days.  
1729 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From Feb 24:  
Days in Feb 1729 = 28, so Feb 24 → Feb 28 is 4 days, remaining 225 days.  
March (31) + April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) = 184 days, leaving 41 days.  
September 30 days → October 11 days.  
Thus new date = 1729-10-11.
